verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a QuickBooks Workforce API covering employee info, deductions, payslips, pensions, and webhooks that fire when a company runs payroll, but nothing documents an API call to preview or calculate a pending payroll run. The in-product Payroll AI that spots time-data inconsistencies and the UI step to review and approve auto payroll are adjacent features, not an API-driven preview an agent can run and review before approval.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent run a payroll preview via the API and surface anomalies for review before I approve the run
